build.description: Post-compile step for @tools/workflows: marks the dist bin entrypoints executable. Depends on `build:tsc` as a graph EDGE rather than shelling out to a nested `nx run`. The nested form spawned a second, separate Nx task graph that re-restored this project's `^build` dependencies (notably @openthrottle/openthrottle-agentic-utils:build) from cache with no coordination against the OUTER graph. Because Nx deletes and recopies a task's declared outputs on a cache hit, that rewrote packages/openthrottle-agentic-utils/dist WHILE this project's Vitest run was importing from it — @tools/workflows resolves that package through its `exports` field, which points at dist, not src. The result was an intermittent ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on a different dist file each time. As a real dependsOn edge, those upstream builds are deduplicated nodes in the one graph and can no longer run concurrently with readers of their output.
